run_speed.label: Run speed
run_speed.help: How fast she runs. 125 crosses the screen in about 3 seconds.

jump_velocity.label: Jump power
jump_velocity.help: Higher = jumps higher. 325 clears a bit over one and a half times her height.

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.help: Higher = rises and falls faster (snappier). Lower = floatier.

jump_cut.label: Short hop
jump_cut.help: How much of the jump is kept when you let go early. Lower = smaller taps. 1 = always a full jump.

air_control.label: Air steering
air_control.help: 1 = steer in the air as freely as on the ground.

backdash_speed.label: Backdash speed
backdash_speed.help: How fast the backdash moves her.

backdash_time.label: Backdash length
backdash_time.help: How long the backdash lasts, in seconds.

backdash_cooldown.label: Backdash wait
backdash_cooldown.help: Wait before the next backdash. 0 = chain them freely.

backdash_safe.label: Backdash safety
backdash_safe.help: Seconds at the start of a backdash where nothing can hurt her.

slide_speed.label: Slide speed
slide_speed.help: How fast she starts a slide. She slows to half of this by the end.

slide_time.label: Slide length
slide_time.help: How long one slide lasts, in seconds.

slide_height.label: Slide height
slide_height.help: How tall she is while sliding. Gaps lower than her standing height but taller than this can be slid under.

slide_cooldown.label: Slide wait
slide_cooldown.help: Wait before the next slide. 0 = chain them freely.

attack_time.label: Attack length
attack_time.help: How long one swing takes, in seconds. Lower = faster attacks.

attack_chain.label: Chain speed (J then I)
attack_chain.help: How soon the next swing can start when you alternate the two attack buttons.

attack_damage.label: Attack damage
attack_damage.help: Damage per hit. The hound has 30 health, the ghost 20.

weapon.label: Weapon in hand
weapon.help: What she swings with. J swings her right hand, I her left. < and > switch.

elegy_time.label: Elegy swing length
elegy_time.help: How long one two-handed swing takes. The short sword takes 0.4; slower means heavier.

hitstop.label: Hit pause
hitstop.help: The tiny freeze when a hit lands. It makes hits feel heavy. 0 = off.

shake.label: Screen shake
shake.help: How much the screen shakes on a hit. 0 = off.

player_hp.label: Her health
player_hp.help: How much damage she can take.

hurt_time.label: Flinch length
hurt_time.help: How long she loses control when hit. There is no knockdown.

hurt_safe.label: Safety after a hit
hurt_safe.help: Seconds she cannot be hit again after taking damage.

hound_warning.label: Hound warning
hound_warning.help: How long the hound flashes before it charges.

ghost_speed.label: Ghost speed
ghost_speed.help: How fast the ghost drifts toward her.

crouch_height.label: Crouch height
crouch_height.help: How tall she is while crouching (Down). Standing she is 36. Lower = ducks under more.

energy_max.label: Energy: amount
energy_max.help: The size of the green Energy bar. Attacks and backdashes spend it.

attack_energy.label: Energy per attack
attack_energy.help: Energy one swing costs. 12 out of 100 = about 8 swings in a row.

energy_refill.label: Energy refill speed
energy_refill.help: Energy gained per second while resting. 45 refills an empty bar in about 2 seconds.

energy_wait.label: Energy refill wait
energy_wait.help: Seconds after spending energy before it starts to refill.

mp_max.label: MP: amount
mp_max.help: The size of the blue MP bar. Only the special attack spends it.

special_cost.label: MP per special
special_cost.help: MP one special attack (Up + Attack) costs. 15 out of 60 = 4 specials. It is only taken when the wave really leaves her hand.

special_damage.label: Special damage
special_damage.help: Damage of the blade wave. 30 kills a hound in one hit.

special_speed.label: Special speed
special_speed.help: How fast the blade wave flies.

special_range.label: Special range
special_range.help: How far the blade wave flies before it fades. The screen is 384 wide.

special_time.label: Special length
special_time.help: How long she is busy throwing the blade wave.

mp_pickup.label: MP per orb
mp_pickup.help: MP one blue orb gives back.

mp_drop_chance.label: Orb drop chance
mp_drop_chance.help: How often a defeated enemy leaves a blue orb. 0.6 = about 6 times in 10.

orb_speed.label: Orb speed
orb_speed.help: How fast a blue orb flies to her.

orb_hang.label: Orb hang
orb_hang.help: Seconds a blue orb hangs in the air before it flies to her.

coyote_time.label: Late jump grace
coyote_time.help: Seconds she can still jump after running off an edge.

jump_buffer.label: Early jump grace
jump_buffer.help: A jump pressed this long before landing still happens.

drop_time.label: Drop-through time
drop_time.help: How long a thin platform lets her fall through after Down + Jump.

hurt_push.label: Push when hit
hurt_push.help: How hard a hit pushes her back and up.

hound_patrol_speed.label: Hound walk speed
hound_patrol_speed.help: How fast the hound walks before it notices her.

hound_notice.label: Hound notice distance
hound_notice.help: How close she must be before the hound starts its warning.

hound_rest.label: Hound rest
hound_rest.help: Seconds the hound rests after a charge. This is your opening.

ghost_notice.label: Ghost notice distance
ghost_notice.help: How close she must be before the ghost starts to chase.

ghost_retreat.label: Ghost back-off
ghost_retreat.help: Seconds the ghost backs away after touching her.

enemy_stun.label: Enemy stagger
enemy_stun.help: Seconds an enemy is stopped after you hit it.

door_open_distance.label: Door: opens when this near
door_open_distance.help: How close she must be before a door slides open. 56 is three and a half floor tiles.

door_time.label: Door: opening time
door_time.help: Seconds a normal door takes to slide open.

boss_door_time.label: Boss door: opening time
boss_door_time.help: Seconds the big boss door takes to grind open.

shot_gravity.label: Enemy shots: how fast they drop
shot_gravity.help: How hard arcing shots (the spitter) fall. Lower = slower, floatier arcs.

hound_hp.label: Hound health
hound_hp.help: Hits needed = this / attack damage. 30 is three Dirge cuts.

hound_damage.label: Hound damage
hound_damage.help: HP she loses when the hound hits her.

hound_pounce.label: Hound pounce height
hound_pounce.help: How hard the hound jumps at her. 255 clears about two and a half tiles.

ghost_damage.label: Ghost damage
ghost_damage.help: HP she loses to the ghost's touch or shriek.

ghost_blink_every.label: Ghost: seconds between blinks
ghost_blink_every.help: How often the ghost vanishes and reappears behind her.

ghost_shriek_warning.label: Ghost: shriek warning
ghost_shriek_warning.help: Seconds between it reappearing and the shriek going off. Longer = easier to step away.

ghost_shriek_radius.label: Ghost: shriek size
ghost_shriek_radius.help: How far the shriek reaches around the ghost. 42 is about two and a half tiles.

choir_damage.label: Choir damage
choir_damage.help: HP she loses to a feather or the dive.

choir_notice.label: Choir: notices her from
choir_notice.help: How far away the winged enemy wakes up.

choir_speed.label: Choir: hover speed
choir_speed.help: How fast it follows her around, up out of reach.

choir_wait.label: Choir: rest between attacks
choir_wait.help: Seconds it hovers between attacks. This is when you can jump up and cut it.

choir_feather_speed.label: Choir: feather speed
choir_feather_speed.help: How fast the three feathers fly.

choir_dive_warning.label: Choir: dive warning
choir_dive_warning.help: Seconds it blinks before it dives through you.

spitter_damage.label: Spitter damage
spitter_damage.help: HP she loses to one of its shots, or to touching it.

spitter_range.label: Spitter: how far it can lob
spitter_range.help: It starts lobbing shots when she is this near.

spitter_burst_range.label: Spitter: burst when this near
spitter_burst_range.help: Closer than this and it sprays a fan of shots instead.

warden_hp.label: Warden health
warden_hp.help: The big brute. 130 is thirteen Dirge cuts or about seven Elegy cuts.

warden_damage.label: Warden damage
warden_damage.help: HP she loses to its claws, its landing or the floor waves.

warden_notice.label: Warden: notices her from
warden_notice.help: How far away it wakes and starts walking at her.

warden_speed.label: Warden: walk speed
warden_speed.help: How fast it walks her down. She runs at 125.

warden_warning.label: Warden: warning
warden_warning.help: Seconds it blinks before a lunge or a leap.

warden_lunge_speed.label: Warden: lunge speed
warden_lunge_speed.help: How fast the claw lunge travels. Backdash or jump it.

warden_leap.label: Warden: leap height
warden_leap.help: How hard it jumps before it slams down.

warden_wave_speed.label: Warden: floor wave speed
warden_wave_speed.help: How fast the two waves run along the floor after it lands. Jump them.

warden_wait.label: Warden: rest between attacks
warden_wait.help: Seconds before it may attack again. This is your opening.

boss_hp.label: Boss health
boss_hp.help: Body hits take full damage; hand hits only a share.

boss_damage.label: Boss damage
boss_damage.help: HP she loses to a hand or a bolt.

boss_hand_share.label: Boss: damage from hitting a hand
boss_hand_share.help: Share of a hit that counts when you cut a hand instead of the body. 0.3 = three tenths.

boss_gap.label: Boss: rest between attacks
boss_gap.help: Seconds between its attacks. Lower = harder.

boss_hand_speed.label: Boss: hand follow speed
boss_hand_speed.help: How fast a hand follows you before it slams.

boss_slam_track.label: Boss: slam follow time
boss_slam_track.help: Seconds the hand follows you before it stops to drop.

boss_slam_hang.label: Boss: slam warning
boss_slam_hang.help: Seconds the hand hangs still before it drops. This is your time to step aside.

boss_stuck.label: Boss: hand stuck time
boss_stuck.help: Seconds a slammed hand stays in the floor as a step. Longer = easier.

boss_sweep_warning.label: Boss: sweep warning
boss_sweep_warning.help: Seconds a hand waits at the wall before it slides across.

boss_sweep_speed.label: Boss: sweep speed
boss_sweep_speed.help: How fast a hand slides across the floor.

boss_bolt_speed.label: Boss: bolt speed
boss_bolt_speed.help: How fast the golden bolts fly.

hit_reach.label: Weapon reach vs. the picture
hit_reach.help: 1.0 = a cut lands exactly where you see the weapon. Higher = it reaches a bit past the tip. Lower = shorter than it looks.

hit_thickness.label: Hit forgiveness
hit_thickness.help: How many pixels a near miss is forgiven by. 0 = the blade must really touch the enemy. 4 = about a quarter of a floor tile of help.

show_hitboxes.label: Show hit areas (0 off, 1 on)
show_hitboxes.help: Draws where the blade cuts (yellow), what can be hit (red) and her own box (green), so you can see why a cut landed or missed.

elegy_damage_mult.label: Elegy: damage x Dirge
elegy_damage_mult.help: How much harder the two-handed scythe hits than one Dirge cut. 2 = double.

elegy_energy_mult.label: Elegy: energy x Dirge
elegy_energy_mult.help: How much more energy one scythe cut costs than one Dirge cut. 1.5 = half as much again.

elegy_special_cost.label: Elegy special (Requiem): MP cost
elegy_special_cost.help: MP the scythe's spinning special costs. It is only taken when the spin really starts.

elegy_special_damage.label: Elegy special: damage per pass
elegy_special_damage.help: The scythe turns round her twice; each half turn can cut every enemy near her once (up to 4 cuts).

elegy_special_time.label: Elegy special: how long it lasts
elegy_special_time.help: Seconds the scythe spins. She cannot be knocked out of it.

elegy_special_radius.label: Elegy special: reach
elegy_special_radius.help: How far from her the scythe turns. The old value was 8.

elegy_special_size.label: Elegy special: scythe size
elegy_special_size.help: How much bigger the scythe is drawn during the spin; the cut follows the picture.

wall_latch_time.label: Wall latch: how long she holds
wall_latch_time.help: Seconds she can cling to a wall before her grip gives out.

wall_latches_per_air.label: Wall latch: latches per jump
wall_latches_per_air.help: How many times she can grab a wall before she has to land again. 1 = one latch and one wall jump.

wall_slide_speed.label: Wall latch: slide speed
wall_slide_speed.help: How fast she slips down while clinging. 0 = she does not slip at all.

wall_jump_velocity.label: Wall jump: height
wall_jump_velocity.help: How hard she kicks upward off a wall. 300 is a little lower than a normal jump.

wall_jump_push.label: Wall jump: push away
wall_jump_push.help: How hard the kick throws her away from the wall.

wall_jump_lock.label: Wall jump: no-steer time
wall_jump_lock.help: Seconds after the kick before you can steer back. Shorter = easier to climb one wall.

fx_amount.label: Effects amount
fx_amount.help: How many sparks, streaks and glowing bits the backdash, slide and specials throw. 0 = none, 2 = twice as many.

fx_flash.label: Screen flash
fx_flash.help: How bright the short screen flash of the specials is. 0 turns flashes off (for players bothered by flashing light).

crab_hp.label: Spine Crab: health
crab_hp.help: How tough the crab is. 70 is seven Dirge cuts (10 each) or four Elegy cuts (20 each).

crab_damage.label: Spine Crab: claw / eruption damage
crab_damage.help: Damage from the claw rush and from the crab bursting out of the floor under her.

crab_touch_damage.label: Spine Crab: bump damage
crab_touch_damage.help: Damage if she just bumps into the crab while it scuttles about.

crab_speed.label: Spine Crab: scuttle speed
crab_speed.help: How fast it scuttles sideways. 95 is a bit slower than her run (125).

crab_notice.label: Spine Crab: notices her at
crab_notice.help: How far away the crab starts to attack. 190 is about twelve tiles.

crab_turn_time.label: Spine Crab: slow to turn
crab_turn_time.help: Seconds it needs to turn round when she gets behind it. Its shell only guards the front.

crab_pinch_warning.label: Spine Crab: claw warning
crab_pinch_warning.help: Seconds the claws stay open (it clicks and blinks orange) before the rush.

crab_rush_speed.label: Spine Crab: claw rush speed
crab_rush_speed.help: How fast it lunges with open claws. 240 crosses the screen in about a second and a half.

crab_rush_time.label: Spine Crab: claw rush length
crab_rush_time.help: Seconds the rush lasts. 0.4 at speed 240 is about six tiles.

crab_rear_warning.label: Spine Crab: rearing warning
crab_rear_warning.help: Seconds it rears up and rattles its spines before it fires them.

crab_spine_speed.label: Spine Crab: spine speed
crab_spine_speed.help: How hard the five spines are flung upward. They arc and fall back around the crab.

crab_spine_gravity.label: Spine Crab: spine fall
crab_spine_gravity.help: How fast the spines drop back down. Higher = they come down sooner and closer.

crab_burrow_time.label: Spine Crab: sinking time
crab_burrow_time.help: Seconds it takes to dig in (it blinks orange and rumbles).

crab_burrow_speed.label: Spine Crab: tunnel speed
crab_burrow_speed.help: How fast it travels under the floor toward her. The dirt line shows where it is.

crab_burrow_chase.label: Spine Crab: tunnel time
crab_burrow_chase.help: Seconds it follows her under the floor before it stops to rumble.

crab_rumble.label: Spine Crab: rumble warning
crab_rumble.help: Seconds the ground bulges and shakes before the crab bursts out. Step away in this time.

crab_rest.label: Spine Crab: rest after an attack
crab_rest.help: Seconds it is slow and open to hits after an attack.

crab_wait.label: Spine Crab: pause between attacks
crab_wait.help: Seconds before the crab starts its next attack.

crab_tink_push.label: Spine Crab: shell knock-back
crab_tink_push.help: How far she is pushed back when her cut bounces off the shell.

moth_hp.label: Censer Moth: health
moth_hp.help: How tough the moth is. 40 is four Dirge cuts.

moth_damage.label: Censer Moth: dive damage
moth_damage.help: Damage if the moth hits her during its ember dive.

moth_speed.label: Censer Moth: flying speed
moth_speed.help: How fast it drifts about when it is not attacking.

moth_notice.label: Censer Moth: notices her at
moth_notice.help: How far away the moth starts hunting her.

moth_veil_warning.label: Censer Moth: incense warning
moth_veil_warning.help: Seconds the censer glows and chimes before the smoke comes out.

moth_cloud_damage.label: Censer Moth: smoke damage
moth_cloud_damage.help: Damage when she touches a smoke cloud.

moth_cloud_life.label: Censer Moth: smoke lasts
moth_cloud_life.help: Seconds each smoke cloud hangs in the room.

moth_cloud_speed.label: Censer Moth: smoke drift
moth_cloud_speed.help: How fast the smoke drifts toward her.

moth_gust_warning.label: Censer Moth: gust warning
moth_gust_warning.help: Seconds the wings are held up before the gust. Brace or move.

moth_gust_push.label: Censer Moth: gust shove
moth_gust_push.help: How far the gust throws her. 56 is three and a half tiles. It does no damage by itself.

moth_dive_warning.label: Censer Moth: dive warning
moth_dive_warning.help: Seconds of shrill fluttering before the ember dive.

moth_dive_time.label: Censer Moth: dive length
moth_dive_time.help: Seconds the swoop takes. Shorter = a faster dive.

moth_ember_damage.label: Censer Moth: ember damage
moth_ember_damage.help: Damage from a falling or burning ember.

moth_ember_burn.label: Censer Moth: ember burn time
moth_ember_burn.help: Seconds an ember keeps burning on the floor.

moth_wait.label: Censer Moth: pause between attacks
moth_wait.help: Seconds before the moth starts its next attack.

scribe_hp.label: Needle Scribe: health
scribe_hp.help: How tough the scribe is. Below half of this it leaves an ink clone.

scribe_damage.label: Needle Scribe: needle / drop damage
scribe_damage.help: Damage from the needle and from the scribe dropping on her.

scribe_glyph_damage.label: Needle Scribe: glyph damage
scribe_glyph_damage.help: Damage from the glyph when it bursts.

scribe_notice.label: Needle Scribe: notices her at
scribe_notice.help: How far away the scribe starts to attack.

scribe_needle_warning.label: Needle Scribe: needle warning
scribe_needle_warning.help: Seconds of glint before the needle flies. The aim is locked for the last 0.2.

scribe_needle_speed.label: Needle Scribe: needle speed
scribe_needle_speed.help: How fast the needle flies. 330 crosses the screen in a bit more than a second.

scribe_pin_time.label: Needle Scribe: pin time
scribe_pin_time.help: Seconds she is pinned and cannot move after a needle hit.

scribe_drip_time.label: Needle Scribe: ink drip warning
scribe_drip_time.help: Seconds an ink drip hangs on the ceiling above her before the scribe drops from it.

scribe_drop_speed.label: Needle Scribe: ink drop speed
scribe_drop_speed.help: How fast the scribe falls from the ceiling.

scribe_glyph_time.label: Needle Scribe: glyph fuse
scribe_glyph_time.help: Seconds from the glyph being drawn to its burst. Step off it.

scribe_glyph_radius.label: Needle Scribe: glyph size
scribe_glyph_radius.help: How wide the glyph burst is. 34 is about two tiles each side.

scribe_wait.label: Needle Scribe: pause between attacks
scribe_wait.help: Seconds before the scribe starts its next attack.

scribe_clone_every.label: Needle Scribe: new ink clone every
scribe_clone_every.help: Below half health, seconds between ink clones. A clone copies its attacks but is harmless and pops when hit.

leech_hp.label: Thread Leech: health
leech_hp.help: How tough the leech is. 25 is three Dirge cuts.

leech_damage.label: Thread Leech: landing damage
leech_damage.help: Damage when the leech lands on her. After that it drains her.

leech_notice.label: Thread Leech: drops when she is within
leech_notice.help: How close to straight under it she must be. 20 is about one tile and a half.

leech_hang.label: Thread Leech: hanging length
leech_hang.help: How far below the ceiling it hangs.

leech_reach.label: Thread Leech: longest drop
leech_reach.help: How far down its thread it can fall.

leech_drop_warning.label: Thread Leech: drip warning
leech_drop_warning.help: Seconds a drop of slime falls before the leech itself drops.

leech_drop_speed.label: Thread Leech: drop speed
leech_drop_speed.help: How fast the leech falls down its thread.

leech_drain_mp.label: Thread Leech: magic drain
leech_drain_mp.help: How much magic (MP) it drains from her each second while latched.

leech_drain_en.label: Thread Leech: energy drain
leech_drain_en.help: How much energy (EN) it drains each second once her magic is gone.

leech_slow.label: Thread Leech: slowing
leech_slow.help: How much of her running speed it takes away while latched. 0.5 = half.

leech_latch_time.label: Thread Leech: longest latch
leech_latch_time.help: Seconds before it lets go by itself.

leech_jumps.label: Thread Leech: jumps to shake it off
leech_jumps.help: How many jumps make it fall off.

leech_attacks.label: Thread Leech: swings to shake it off
leech_attacks.help: How many sword swings make it fall off.

leech_stun.label: Thread Leech: stunned after falling
leech_stun.help: Seconds it lies stunned on the floor, open to hits.

leech_climb_speed.label: Thread Leech: climbing speed
leech_climb_speed.help: How fast it climbs back up its thread.

leech_wait.label: Thread Leech: pause before dropping again
leech_wait.help: Seconds before it can drop again after climbing back.

pendulum_damage.label: Pendulum blade: damage
pendulum_damage.help: Damage from touching the swinging blade.

pendulum_period.label: Pendulum blade: swing time
pendulum_period.help: Seconds for one full swing there and back.

pendulum_angle.label: Pendulum blade: swing angle
pendulum_angle.help: How far to each side the blade swings, in degrees.

pendulum_clearance.label: Pendulum blade: height above floor
pendulum_clearance.help: How high the blade passes above the floor at its lowest. 24 is one and a half tiles.

crusher_damage.label: Crusher: damage
crusher_damage.help: Damage if she is under the crusher when it slams or while it sits on the floor.

crusher_wait.label: Crusher: time up
crusher_wait.help: Seconds the crusher stays up between slams.

crusher_warn.label: Crusher: warning
crusher_warn.help: Seconds it rattles and drops dust before it slams.

crusher_sit.label: Crusher: time down
crusher_sit.help: Seconds it stays on the floor after the slam.

crusher_rise.label: Crusher: rising time
crusher_rise.help: Seconds it takes to rise back up.

flame_damage.label: Flame vent: damage
flame_damage.help: Damage from standing in the flame.

flame_idle.label: Flame vent: quiet time
flame_idle.help: Seconds the vent is quiet between flames.

flame_warn.label: Flame vent: warning
flame_warn.help: Seconds the grate glows and hisses before the flame.

flame_height.label: Flame vent: flame height
flame_height.help: How tall the flame is. 56 is three and a half tiles.

spikes_damage.label: Floor spikes: damage
spikes_damage.help: Damage from standing on the spikes when they are up.

spikes_hidden.label: Floor spikes: hidden time
spikes_hidden.help: Seconds the spikes stay hidden between thrusts.

spikes_warn.label: Floor spikes: warning
spikes_warn.help: Seconds the floor glints and rumbles before the spikes come up.

hole_pop.label: Pop out of a hole
hole_pop.help: How hard she is thrown up when she comes out of a hole in a floor. 280 lifts her about three tiles, enough to step onto the floor beside the hole.

crack_hits.label: Hits to break the cracked wall
crack_hits.help: How many weapon cuts the cracked wall takes before it crumbles.

bars_rise_time.label: Iron bars: rising time
bars_rise_time.help: How long the iron bars take to rise once the lever behind them is cut.

lever_reach.label: Lever: pull distance
lever_reach.help: How close she must stand to pull the library lever with Up. 22 is about one and a half tiles.

shift_tear_time.label: The shift: tearing time
shift_tear_time.help: How long the picture rips and goes white when the machine is switched on. 2.2 is a little over two seconds.

shift_whisper_min.label: Voices: shortest wait
shift_whisper_min.help: After the shift, the least time (seconds) between two whispers or chants.

shift_whisper_max.label: Voices: longest wait
shift_whisper_max.help: After the shift, the most time (seconds) between two whispers or chants.

shift_noise.label: Shifted picture: grain
shift_noise.help: How much film grain covers the picture after the shift. 0 = clean.

shift_tear_chance.label: Shifted picture: tearing
shift_tear_chance.help: How often a band of the picture slips sideways after the shift. 0 = never, 1 = all the time.

boss_reap_warn.label: Pallbearer: scythe warning
boss_reap_warn.help: How long a hand holds the glowing scythe before the sweep or the throw. Longer = easier to read.

boss_reap_speed.label: Pallbearer: scythe sweep speed
boss_reap_speed.help: How fast the scythe crosses the room in the sweep. 190 takes about two seconds.

boss_reap_high.label: Pallbearer: high sweep height
boss_reap_high.help: Height above the floor of the chest-high scythe. She ducks or slides under it. Keep it above 28 so crouching works.

boss_reap_low.label: Pallbearer: low sweep height
boss_reap_low.help: Height above the floor of the low scythe. She jumps over it.

boss_reap_thick.label: Pallbearer: scythe thickness
boss_reap_thick.help: How tall the dangerous part of the scythe is, in pixels.

boss_throw_speed.label: Pallbearer: thrown scythe speed
